content.introduction: The Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting on September 15-16, 2026, will have its FOMC Meeting Statement released on September 16, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. The minutes of the meeting are scheduled to be released on October 7, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. EDT. The FOMC voted 12–0 to raise the target range by 25 basis points at this meeting, citing elevated inflation and aiming for a return to the 2% goal. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for October 27-28, 2026.

Implementation Note (Released September 16, 2026 at 2:00 p.m.)

Heading into theOctober 27–28, 2026 meeting, the confirmed starting point is the current target range of 3.75% – 4%. At its September 15–16, 2026 meeting, the FOMC voted 12–0 to raise the range by 25 basis points. The September 16 policy statement said inflation remained elevated and that the increase would support a timelier return to its 2% goal. That official record does not guarantee a hold, hike, or cut at the next meeting.

### What is known before the announcement [...] The eight scheduled 2026 FOMC meetings are January 27–28; March 17–18; April 28–29; June 16–17; July 28–29; September 15–16; October 27–28; and December 8–9. The March, June, September, and December meetings include the Summary of Economic Projections (SEP).

October 07, 2026

### Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026

For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT

 Share

The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released the minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting that was held on September 15–16, 2026. [...] The minutes for each regularly scheduled meeting of the Committee are generally published three weeks after the day of the policy decision. The descriptions of economic and financial conditions contained in these minutes are based solely on the information that was available to the Committee at the time of the meeting.

The minutes can be viewed on the Board's website.
